title: gastrolobium minus
intro: Gastrolobium minus, commonly known as poison, is a plant species native to Western Australia. It has been used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Gastrolobium minus include vasodilation and antioxidant activity, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. However, due to its toxic properties, it is essential to use this plant under the guidance of a medical professional or in controlled environments for research purposes.
